links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy versus blinded human review of 400 sampled reports
links.effect: Accuracy 84.2% (kappa 0.685) for distal biceps and 85.2% (kappa 0.705) for common extensor; common extensor systematically over-classified (sensitivity 96.1%, specificity 78.5%, McNemar p<0.001).
links.quote: Human validation of 400 reports demonstrated substantial agreement for both variables (distal biceps: accuracy 84.2%, κ = 0.685; common extensor: accuracy 85.2%, κ = 0.705).

unlisted_practices: Using locally deployed LLM extraction of structured data from radiology reports for imaging epidemiology, validated against human review

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates an LLM pipeline for information extraction from clinical radiology reports to support epidemiological research, measuring extraction reliability against human validation.
